SELECT pb.prompt_id, pb.origin, pb.prompt_kind, pb.parent_prompt_id, pb.thread_label, pb.text, pb.blob_key, pb.created_at,
    (SELECT MAX(+created_at) FROM responses WHERE project_id = pb.project_id AND session_id = pb.session_id AND prompt_id = pb.prompt_id) AS last_reply,
    (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('toolName', tool_name, 'count', n)) FROM (
      SELECT tool_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM tool_calls WHERE project_id = pb.project_id AND session_id = pb.session_id AND prompt_id = pb.prompt_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = tool_calls.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = tool_calls.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = tool_calls.prompt_id)
    GROUP BY +tool_name ORDER BY n DESC, tool_name ASC)) AS tools,
    (SELECT json_object('receiptId', i.id, 'sporeIds', i.spore_ids, 'createdAt', i.created_at, 'planIds', json(COALESCE(i.plan_ids, '[]')))
      FROM spore_injections i WHERE i.project_id = pb.project_id AND i.session_id = pb.session_id AND i.delivered_prompt_id = pb.prompt_id
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = i.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = i.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = i.delivered_prompt_id)
      ORDER BY +i.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS injection,
    (SELECT agent FROM sessions s WHERE s.project_id = pb.project_id AND s.session_id = pb.session_id) AS agent
    FROM (SELECT value AS wanted_prompt FROM json_each(?)) wanted CROSS JOIN prompt_batches pb
    WHERE pb.project_id = ? AND pb.session_id = ? AND pb.prompt_id = wanted.wanted_prompt

    SELECT response_id, prompt_id, text, blob_key, created_at, created_at AS order_at, response_id,

    WHERE project_id = ? AND session_id = ? AND prompt_id = wanted.wanted_prompt

    AND hook_prompt.session_id = attachments.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = attachments.prompt_id) THEN attachments.prompt_id ELSE NULL END AS prompt_id, attachment_id, blob_key, media_type, byte_size, description, created_at, created_at AS order_at, attachment_id,

SELECT r.project_id, r.session_id, r.kind FROM (SELECT r.* FROM projects pr CROSS JOIN session_injections r WHERE r.project_id = pr.project_id AND r.project_id = ? AND r.session_id = ?) r
    WHERE r.kind >= 'cortex:' AND r.kind < 'cortex;'

SELECT r.placement_hint AS prompt_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT si.*, (SELECT MAX(json_extract(e.payload, '$.parentPromptId')) FROM events e INDEXED BY idx_events_subagent_start
      WHERE e.project_id = si.project_id AND e.session_id = si.session_id AND e.kind = 'subagent.start'
        AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.subagentId') = json_extract(agent.value, '$.subagent_id')
      HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT json_extract(e.payload, '$.parentPromptId')) = 1
        AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(json_extract(e.payload, '$.parentPromptId'))) AS placement_hint
      FROM json_each(?) agent CROSS JOIN session_injections si
      WHERE si.project_id = json_extract(agent.value, '$.project_id') AND si.session_id = json_extract(agent.value, '$.session_id')
        AND si.kind = json_extract(agent.value, '$.kind')
      UNION ALL SELECT si.*, si.delivered_prompt_id AS placement_hint FROM (SELECT r.* FROM projects pr CROSS JOIN session_injections r WHERE r.project_id = pr.project_id AND r.project_id = ? AND r.session_id = ?) si
      WHERE si.kind = 'plan-nudge' AND si.delivered_at IS NOT NULL) r
    WHERE r.project_id = ? AND r.session_id = ? AND r.kind LIKE 'cortex:%'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = r.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = r.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = r.placement_hint)
    GROUP BY r.placement_hint

SELECT prompt_id, text, blob_key, origin, prompt_kind, parent_prompt_id, thread_label, created_at, created_at AS order_at, prompt_id FROM prompt_batches
                WHERE project_id = ? AND session_id = ?
                ORDER BY created_at ASC, prompt_id ASC LIMIT ?

SELECT kind, created_at, delivery, created_at AS order_at, kind FROM (SELECT project_id, session_id, kind, created_at, NULL AS delivery FROM session_injections
     UNION ALL
     SELECT project_id, session_id, 'context:' || id AS kind, created_at,
       CASE WHEN delivered_at IS NULL THEN 'not_delivered' ELSE 'unnamed_prompt' END AS delivery
       FROM prompt_context_answers WHERE outcome = 'served' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = prompt_context_answers.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = prompt_context_answers.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = prompt_context_answers.delivered_prompt_id)
     UNION ALL
     SELECT r.project_id, r.session_id, 'context:' || r.id AS kind, r.created_at,
       CASE WHEN r.delivered_at IS NULL THEN 'not_delivered' ELSE 'unnamed_prompt' END AS delivery
       FROM spore_injections r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = r.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = r.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = r.delivered_prompt_id)
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_context_answers a
                          WHERE a.project_id = r.project_id AND a.session_id = r.session_id AND a.receipt_id = r.id))
                WHERE project_id = ? AND session_id = ?
                ORDER BY created_at ASC, kind ASC LIMIT ?

    AND hook_prompt.session_id = tool_calls.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = tool_calls.prompt_id) THEN tool_calls.prompt_id ELSE NULL END AS prompt_id, tool_call_id, tool_name, myco_tool, myco_op, substr(input, 1, 2048) AS input_preview,
    COALESCE(input_bytes, length(CAST(input AS BLOB)), (SELECT b.size FROM blobs b WHERE b.project_id = tool_calls.project_id AND b.key = tool_calls.input_blob_key)) AS input_bytes,

                WHERE project_id = ? AND session_id = ?

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = attachments.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = attachments.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = attachments.prompt_id) THEN attachments.prompt_id ELSE NULL END AS prompt_id, attachment_id, blob_key, media_type, byte_size, description, created_at, created_at AS order_at, attachment_id FROM attachments
                WHERE project_id = ? AND session_id = ?
                ORDER BY created_at ASC, attachment_id ASC LIMIT ?

SELECT pb.prompt_id, substr(pb.text, 1, ?) AS prompt,
                     (SELECT substr(r.text, 1, ?) FROM responses r
                       WHERE r.project_id = pb.project_id AND r.session_id = pb.session_id AND r.prompt_id = pb.prompt_id AND r.text IS NOT NULL
                       ORDER BY r.created_at, r.response_id LIMIT 1) AS response
                FROM prompt_batches pb
               WHERE pb.project_id = ? AND pb.session_id = ? AND pb.origin = 'user' AND pb.text IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transcripts t
  WHERE t.project_id = pb.project_id AND t.session_id = pb.session_id AND ((t.parsed_offset < t.size OR t.parse_error IS NOT NULL))) ORDER BY pb.created_at ASC, pb.prompt_id ASC LIMIT ?

SELECT 1 FROM transcripts t WHERE t.project_id = ? AND t.session_id = ?
    AND ((t.parsed_offset < t.size OR t.parse_error IS NOT NULL)) LIMIT 1

SELECT pb.prompt_id, substr(pb.text, 1, ?) AS prompt,

                       WHERE r.project_id = pb.project_id AND r.session_id = pb.session_id AND r.prompt_id = pb.prompt_id AND r.text IS NOT NULL
                       ORDER BY r.created_at, r.response_id LIMIT 1) AS response
                FROM prompt_batches pb
               WHERE pb.project_id = ? AND pb.session_id = ? AND pb.origin = 'user' AND pb.text IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transcripts t
  WHERE t.project_id = pb.project_id AND t.session_id = pb.session_id AND ((t.parsed_offset < t.size OR t.parse_error IS NOT NULL))) ORDER BY pb.created_at DESC, pb.prompt_id DESC LIMIT ?

     s.agent, s.branch, COALESCE(s.occurred_started_at, s.started_at) AS started_at, COALESCE(s.occurred_ended_at, s.ended_at) AS ended_at, s.origin_path, s.parent_session_id, s.parent_reason, s.launch_parent_session_id,
     s.title, s.summary, s.titled_at, s.ended_by, (SELECT substr(pb.text, 1, 160) FROM prompt_batches pb
       WHERE pb.project_id = s.project_id AND pb.session_id = s.session_id AND pb.origin = 'user' AND pb.text IS NOT NULL
       ORDER BY pb.created_at, pb.prompt_id LIMIT 1) AS first_prompt,
     c.member_id, c.runtime_kind, m.label AS member_label, e.label AS ended_by_label, s.working_since FROM sessions s
     LEFT JOIN member_credentials c ON c.id = s.created_by_token_id
     LEFT JOIN members m ON m.id = c.member_id
     LEFT JOIN members e ON e.id = s.ended_by WHERE s.project_id = ? AND s.session_id = ? AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM session_tombstones t WHERE t.project_id = s.project_id AND t.session_id = s.session_id)

SELECT c.lineage_root AS lineage, MIN(c.lineage_started_at) AS started,
                     MIN((SELECT MIN(x.created_at) FROM (
                            SELECT i.created_at, i.project_id, i.session_id FROM spore_injections i
                            UNION ALL
                            SELECT s.created_at, s.project_id, s.session_id FROM session_injections s) x
                          WHERE x.project_id = sess.project_id AND x.session_id = sess.session_id)) AS first_served
                FROM member_credentials c
                JOIN sessions sess ON sess.created_by_token_id = c.id
               WHERE 1 = 1
               GROUP BY c.lineage_root

SELECT COALESCE((
  SELECT t.agent FROM transcripts t
   WHERE t.project_id = p.project_id AND t.session_id = p.session_id AND t.role = 'primary'
   ORDER BY t.first_received_at LIMIT 1), 'unrecorded') AS harness, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(p.prompt_kind = 'unrecognized') AS "unrecognized", SUM(p.prompt_kind = 'unmarked') AS "unmarked", SUM(p.prompt_kind = 'opener_conflict') AS "opener_conflict", SUM(p.prompt_kind = 'contract_violation') AS "contract_violation", SUM(p.claim = 'reused') AS reused
        FROM projects pr CROSS JOIN prompt_batches p WHERE p.project_id = pr.project_id AND p.claim IS NOT NULL AND 1 = 1 GROUP BY harness

SELECT COALESCE((
  SELECT t.agent FROM transcripts t
   WHERE t.project_id = c.project_id AND t.session_id = c.session_id AND t.role = 'primary'
   ORDER BY t.first_received_at LIMIT 1), 'unrecorded') AS harness, COUNT(*) AS n FROM projects pr CROSS JOIN prompt_identity_conflicts c

SELECT t.agent AS harness, COUNT(*) AS n FROM transcripts t WHERE t.prompt_identity_scheme IS NULL
        AND t.agent IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) AND 1 = 1 GROUP BY t.agent

  SELECT t.agent FROM transcripts t
   WHERE t.project_id = a.project_id AND t.session_id = a.session_id AND t.role = 'primary'

WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.rowid AS source_rowid, sessions_fts.rank AS rank, 0 AS branch, sessions_fts.rowid AS match_rowid
    FROM sessions_fts CROSS JOIN sessions d ON d.rowid = sessions_fts.rowid
    WHERE sessions_fts MATCH ? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.project_id = d.project_id AND p.archived_at IS NULL)),
    kept AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.project_id, d.session_id AS id, COALESCE(NULLIF(d.title, ''), 'Session ' || substr(d.session_id, -6)) AS title, MIN(candidates.rank) AS rank,
      candidates.branch, candidates.match_rowid, NULL AS line,
      COALESCE(d.occurred_started_at, d.started_at, d.first_received_at) AS created_at, d.session_id AS session_id, NULL AS prompt_id
    FROM candidates CROSS JOIN sessions d ON d.rowid = candidates.source_rowid
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM session_tombstones t WHERE t.project_id = d.project_id AND t.session_id = d.session_id) GROUP BY d.rowid ORDER BY rank, created_at DESC, id, d.project_id LIMIT ?)
    SELECT kept.project_id, kept.id, kept.title, kept.rank, kept.created_at, kept.session_id, kept.prompt_id, (SELECT agent FROM sessions WHERE project_id = kept.project_id AND session_id = kept.session_id) AS agent, (SELECT snippet(sessions_fts, -1, '', '', ' … ', 40) FROM sessions_fts WHERE sessions_fts MATCH ? AND sessions_fts.rowid = kept.match_rowid) AS preview
    FROM kept  ORDER BY kept.rank, kept.created_at DESC, kept.id, kept.project_id

WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.rowid AS source_rowid, spores_fts.rank AS rank, 0 AS branch, spores_fts.rowid AS match_rowid
    FROM spores_fts CROSS JOIN spores d ON d.rowid = spores_fts.rowid
    WHERE spores_fts MATCH ? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.project_id = d.project_id AND p.archived_at IS NULL)),
    kept AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.project_id, d.id AS id, d.observation_type AS title, MIN(candidates.rank) AS rank,
      candidates.branch, candidates.match_rowid, d.agent_line AS line,
      d.created_at AS created_at, d.session_id AS session_id, NULL AS prompt_id
    FROM candidates CROSS JOIN spores d ON d.rowid = candidates.source_rowid
     GROUP BY d.rowid ORDER BY rank, created_at DESC, id, d.project_id LIMIT ?)
    SELECT kept.project_id, kept.id, kept.title, kept.rank, kept.created_at, kept.session_id, kept.prompt_id, (SELECT agent FROM sessions WHERE project_id = kept.project_id AND session_id = kept.session_id) AS agent, COALESCE(NULLIF(kept.line, ''), (SELECT snippet(spores_fts, -1, '', '', ' … ', 40) FROM spores_fts WHERE spores_fts MATCH ? AND spores_fts.rowid = kept.match_rowid)) AS preview
    FROM kept  ORDER BY kept.rank, kept.created_at DESC, kept.id, kept.project_id

WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.rowid AS source_rowid, plans_fts.rank AS rank, 0 AS branch, plans_fts.rowid AS match_rowid
    FROM plans_fts CROSS JOIN plans d ON d.rowid = plans_fts.rowid
    WHERE plans_fts MATCH ? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.project_id = d.project_id AND p.archived_at IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT d.rowid AS source_rowid, search_blob_chunks_fts.rank AS rank, 1 AS branch,
    search_blob_chunks_fts.rowid AS match_rowid
    FROM search_blob_chunks_fts CROSS JOIN search_blob_chunks c ON c.rowid = search_blob_chunks_fts.rowid
    CROSS JOIN plans d ON d.project_id = c.project_id AND d.blob_key = c.blob_key
    WHERE search_blob_chunks_fts MATCH ? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.project_id = d.project_id AND p.archived_at IS NULL) AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM processed_resources pr WHERE pr.project_id = d.project_id AND pr.kind = 'plan'
    AND pr.resource_id = d.plan_key AND pr.blob_key = d.blob_key AND pr.classification = 'processed')),
    kept AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.project_id, d.plan_key AS id, COALESCE(NULLIF(d.title, ''), 'Plan') AS title, MIN(candidates.rank) AS rank,
      candidates.branch, candidates.match_rowid, NULL AS line,
      d.created_at AS created_at, d.session_id AS session_id, d.prompt_id AS prompt_id
    FROM candidates CROSS JOIN plans d ON d.rowid = candidates.source_rowid
     GROUP BY d.rowid ORDER BY rank, created_at DESC, id, d.project_id LIMIT ?)
    SELECT kept.project_id, kept.id, kept.title, kept.rank, kept.created_at, kept.session_id, kept.prompt_id, (SELECT agent FROM sessions WHERE project_id = kept.project_id AND session_id = kept.session_id) AS agent, CASE kept.branch WHEN 0 THEN (SELECT snippet(plans_fts, -1, '', '', ' … ', 40) FROM plans_fts WHERE plans_fts MATCH ? AND plans_fts.rowid = kept.match_rowid) ELSE (SELECT snippet(search_blob_chunks_fts, 0, '', '', ' … ', 40) FROM search_blob_chunks_fts
    WHERE search_blob_chunks_fts MATCH ? AND search_blob_chunks_fts.rowid = kept.match_rowid) END AS preview
    FROM kept  ORDER BY kept.rank, kept.created_at DESC, kept.id, kept.project_id

WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.rowid AS source_rowid, prompt_batches_fts.rank AS rank, 0 AS branch, prompt_batches_fts.rowid AS match_rowid
    FROM prompt_batches_fts CROSS JOIN prompt_batches d ON d.rowid = prompt_batches_fts.rowid
    WHERE prompt_batches_fts MATCH ? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.project_id = d.project_id AND p.archived_at IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT d.rowid AS source_rowid, search_blob_chunks_fts.rank AS rank, 1 AS branch,
    search_blob_chunks_fts.rowid AS match_rowid
    FROM search_blob_chunks_fts CROSS JOIN search_blob_chunks c ON c.rowid = search_blob_chunks_fts.rowid
    CROSS JOIN prompt_batches d ON d.project_id = c.project_id AND d.blob_key = c.blob_key
    WHERE search_blob_chunks_fts MATCH ? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.project_id = d.project_id AND p.archived_at IS NULL) AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM processed_resources pr WHERE pr.project_id = d.project_id AND pr.kind = 'prompt'
    AND pr.resource_id = d.prompt_id AND pr.blob_key = d.blob_key AND pr.classification = 'processed')),
    kept AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.project_id, d.prompt_id AS id, 'Prompt' AS title, MIN(candidates.rank) AS rank,
      candidates.branch, candidates.match_rowid, NULL AS line,
      d.created_at AS created_at, d.session_id AS session_id, d.prompt_id AS prompt_id
    FROM candidates CROSS JOIN prompt_batches d ON d.rowid = candidates.source_rowid
     GROUP BY d.rowid ORDER BY rank, created_at DESC, id, d.project_id LIMIT ?)
    SELECT kept.project_id, kept.id, kept.title, kept.rank, kept.created_at, kept.session_id, kept.prompt_id, (SELECT agent FROM sessions WHERE project_id = kept.project_id AND session_id = kept.session_id) AS agent, CASE kept.branch WHEN 0 THEN (SELECT snippet(prompt_batches_fts, -1, '', '', ' … ', 40) FROM prompt_batches_fts WHERE prompt_batches_fts MATCH ? AND prompt_batches_fts.rowid = kept.match_rowid) ELSE (SELECT snippet(search_blob_chunks_fts, 0, '', '', ' … ', 40) FROM search_blob_chunks_fts
    WHERE search_blob_chunks_fts MATCH ? AND search_blob_chunks_fts.rowid = kept.match_rowid) END AS preview, tp.prompt_id AS turn_id, substr(tp.text, 1, 160) AS turn_preview, length(tp.text) AS turn_chars, tp.blob_key IS NOT NULL AS turn_stored
    FROM kept LEFT JOIN prompt_batches rp ON rp.project_id = kept.project_id AND rp.session_id = kept.session_id AND rp.prompt_id = kept.prompt_id
    LEFT JOIN prompt_batches tp ON tp.project_id = rp.project_id AND tp.session_id = rp.session_id AND tp.prompt_id = COALESCE(rp.parent_prompt_id, rp.prompt_id) AND tp.parent_prompt_id IS NULL ORDER BY kept.rank, kept.created_at DESC, kept.id, kept.project_id

WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.rowid AS source_rowid, responses_fts.rank AS rank, 0 AS branch, responses_fts.rowid AS match_rowid
    FROM responses_fts CROSS JOIN responses d ON d.rowid = responses_fts.rowid
    WHERE responses_fts MATCH ? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.project_id = d.project_id AND p.archived_at IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT d.rowid AS source_rowid, search_blob_chunks_fts.rank AS rank, 1 AS branch,

    CROSS JOIN responses d ON d.project_id = c.project_id AND d.blob_key = c.blob_key
    WHERE search_blob_chunks_fts MATCH ? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.project_id = d.project_id AND p.archived_at IS NULL) AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM processed_resources pr WHERE pr.project_id = d.project_id AND pr.kind = 'response'
    AND pr.resource_id = d.response_id AND pr.blob_key = d.blob_key AND pr.classification = 'processed')),
    kept AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.project_id, d.response_id AS id, 'Response' AS title, MIN(candidates.rank) AS rank,

    FROM candidates CROSS JOIN responses d ON d.rowid = candidates.source_rowid

    SELECT kept.project_id, kept.id, kept.title, kept.rank, kept.created_at, kept.session_id, kept.prompt_id, (SELECT agent FROM sessions WHERE project_id = kept.project_id AND session_id = kept.session_id) AS agent, CASE kept.branch WHEN 0 THEN (SELECT snippet(responses_fts, -1, '', '', ' … ', 40) FROM responses_fts WHERE responses_fts MATCH ? AND responses_fts.rowid = kept.match_rowid) ELSE (SELECT snippet(search_blob_chunks_fts, 0, '', '', ' … ', 40) FROM search_blob_chunks_fts
    WHERE search_blob_chunks_fts MATCH ? AND search_blob_chunks_fts.rowid = kept.match_rowid) END AS preview, tp.prompt_id AS turn_id, substr(tp.text, 1, 160) AS turn_preview, length(tp.text) AS turn_chars, tp.blob_key IS NOT NULL AS turn_stored
    FROM kept LEFT JOIN prompt_batches rp ON rp.project_id = kept.project_id AND rp.session_id = kept.session_id AND rp.prompt_id = kept.prompt_id
    LEFT JOIN prompt_batches tp ON tp.project_id = rp.project_id AND tp.session_id = rp.session_id AND tp.prompt_id = COALESCE(rp.parent_prompt_id, rp.prompt_id) AND tp.parent_prompt_id IS NULL ORDER BY kept.rank, kept.created_at DESC, kept.id, kept.project_id

    WHERE q.complete = 0 AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches p WHERE p.project_id = q.project_id AND p.blob_key = q.blob_key AND EXISTS (

    AND pr.resource_id = p.prompt_id AND pr.blob_key = p.blob_key AND pr.classification = 'processed'))
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM responses r WHERE r.project_id = q.project_id AND r.blob_key = q.blob_key AND EXISTS (

  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plans p WHERE p.project_id = q.project_id AND p.blob_key = q.blob_key AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM processed_resources pr WHERE pr.project_id = p.project_id AND pr.kind = 'plan'
    AND pr.resource_id = p.plan_key AND pr.blob_key = p.blob_key AND pr.classification = 'processed'))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.project_id = q.project_id AND p.archived_at IS NULL)
SELECT 1 AS present FROM projects WHERE project_id = ?

SELECT s.session_id, s.machine_id, s.created_by_token_id, s.first_received_at, s.last_received_at,
     s.agent, s.branch, COALESCE(s.occurred_started_at, s.started_at) AS started_at, COALESCE(s.occurred_ended_at, s.ended_at) AS ended_at, s.origin_path, s.parent_session_id, s.parent_reason, s.launch_parent_session_id,
     s.title, s.summary, s.titled_at, s.ended_by, (SELECT substr(pb.text, 1, 160) FROM prompt_batches pb
       WHERE pb.project_id = s.project_id AND pb.session_id = s.session_id AND pb.origin = 'user' AND pb.text IS NOT NULL
       ORDER BY pb.created_at, pb.prompt_id LIMIT 1) AS first_prompt,
     c.member_id, c.runtime_kind, m.label AS member_label, e.label AS ended_by_label, s.working_since FROM sessions s
     LEFT JOIN member_credentials c ON c.id = s.created_by_token_id
     LEFT JOIN members m ON m.id = c.member_id
     LEFT JOIN members e ON e.id = s.ended_by WHERE s.project_id = ? AND s.session_id = ? AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM session_tombstones t WHERE t.project_id = s.project_id AND t.session_id = s.session_id)

SELECT r.project_id, r.session_id, r.kind FROM (SELECT r.* FROM projects pr CROSS JOIN session_injections r WHERE r.project_id = pr.project_id AND r.project_id = ? AND r.session_id = ?) r
    WHERE r.kind >= 'cortex:' AND r.kind < 'cortex;'

SELECT r.placement_hint AS prompt_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT si.*, (SELECT MAX(json_extract(e.payload, '$.parentPromptId')) FROM events e INDEXED BY idx_events_subagent_start
      WHERE e.project_id = si.project_id AND e.session_id = si.session_id AND e.kind = 'subagent.start'
        AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.subagentId') = json_extract(agent.value, '$.subagent_id')
      HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT json_extract(e.payload, '$.parentPromptId')) = 1
        AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(json_extract(e.payload, '$.parentPromptId'))) AS placement_hint
      FROM json_each(?) agent CROSS JOIN session_injections si
      WHERE si.project_id = json_extract(agent.value, '$.project_id') AND si.session_id = json_extract(agent.value, '$.session_id')
        AND si.kind = json_extract(agent.value, '$.kind')
      UNION ALL SELECT si.*, si.delivered_prompt_id AS placement_hint FROM (SELECT r.* FROM projects pr CROSS JOIN session_injections r WHERE r.project_id = pr.project_id AND r.project_id = ? AND r.session_id = ?) si
      WHERE si.kind = 'plan-nudge' AND si.delivered_at IS NOT NULL) r
    WHERE r.project_id = ? AND r.session_id = ? AND r.kind LIKE 'cortex:%'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = r.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = r.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = r.placement_hint)
    GROUP BY r.placement_hint

SELECT agent, started_at, ended_at, ended_by, occurred_started_at, occurred_ended_at,

SELECT CASE WHEN s.title IS NOT NULL OR s.ended_at IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN NOT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transcripts t
  WHERE t.project_id = s.project_id AND t.session_id = s.session_id AND ((t.parsed_offset < t.size OR t.parse_error IS NOT NULL))) THEN 'capture_pending'
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches pb
  WHERE pb.project_id = s.project_id AND pb.session_id = s.session_id AND pb.origin = 'user' AND pb.text IS NOT NULL) THEN 'no_material'
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_runs r WHERE r.project_id = s.project_id AND r.task = 'title-summary'
    AND r.status IN ('pending', 'running', 'queued')
    AND json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(r.run_context) THEN r.run_context END, '$.session_id') = s.session_id) THEN 'in_progress'
      WHEN s.titling_attempts >= 3 THEN 'stopped'
      WHEN s.titling_requested_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transcripts t WHERE t.project_id = s.project_id AND t.session_id = s.session_id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transcripts t WHERE t.project_id = s.project_id AND t.session_id = s.session_id AND t.imported_at IS NULL) THEN 'imported'
      ELSE 'waiting' END AS reason FROM sessions s WHERE s.project_id = ? AND s.session_id = ?

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM prompt_batches WHERE project_id = ? AND session_id = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM tool_calls WHERE project_id = ? AND session_id = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM responses WHERE project_id = ? AND session_id = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM plans WHERE project_id = ? AND session_id = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM attachments WHERE project_id = ? AND session_id = ?

SELECT id, namespace, record_id AS recordId, state, confidence,
  basis_kind AS basisKind, basis_ref AS basisRef, basis_sha AS basisSha,
  release_pr_number AS releasePrNumber, reason, checked_at AS checkedAt, json_extract(evidence_json, '$.source') AS source FROM knowledge_release_state
     WHERE project_id = ? AND namespace IN (?, ?) AND record_id = ? ORDER BY checked_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id AS runId, r.task, r.status, r.started_at AS startedAt, r.completed_at AS completedAt, x.readAt,
    COALESCE(CASE WHEN json_valid(run_context) THEN json_extract(run_context, '$.session_id') END = ?, 0) AS target,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_run_events e WHERE e.project_id = r.project_id AND e.run_id = r.id AND e.event_type = ? AND e.tool_name = ?) AS wroteTitle,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spores s2 WHERE s2.project_id = r.project_id AND s2.author = r.id AND s2.session_id = ?) AS spores
  FROM (SELECT runId, MIN(readAt) AS readAt FROM (
          SELECT run_id AS runId, received_at AS readAt FROM run_reads WHERE project_id = ? AND session_id = ?
          UNION ALL
          SELECT author AS runId, NULL AS readAt FROM spores WHERE project_id = ? AND session_id = ? AND author IS NOT NULL
          UNION ALL
          SELECT id AS runId, NULL AS readAt FROM agent_runs WHERE project_id = ? AND CASE WHEN json_valid(run_context) THEN json_extract(run_context, '$.session_id') END = ?)
        GROUP BY runId) x
  JOIN agent_runs r ON r.project_id = ? AND r.id = x.runId
  ORDER BY COALESCE(r.started_at, r.queued_at, x.readAt) DESC, r.id DESC
  LIMIT ?

SELECT sp.id, sp.observation_type AS observationType, sp.status, sp.agent_line AS agentLine,
  sp.session_id AS sessionId, sp.created_at AS createdAt,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_runs r WHERE r.project_id = sp.project_id AND r.id = sp.author) THEN sp.author END AS runId FROM spores sp WHERE sp.project_id = ? AND sp.session_id = ?
  ORDER BY sp.created_at DESC, sp.id DESC LIMIT ?
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM spores WHERE project_id = ? AND session_id = ?
SELECT 1 AS present FROM sessions WHERE project_id = ? AND session_id = ? AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM session_tombstones t WHERE t.project_id = ? AND t.session_id = ?)

SELECT pb.prompt_id, pb.origin, pb.prompt_kind, pb.thread_label, substr(pb.text, 1, 160) AS preview, length(pb.text) AS text_chars, pb.blob_key, pb.created_at,
                     (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tool_calls t WHERE t.project_id = pb.project_id AND t.session_id = pb.session_id AND t.prompt_id = pb.prompt_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = t.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = t.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = t.prompt_id)) AS tool_call_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM responses r WHERE r.project_id = pb.project_id AND r.prompt_id = pb.prompt_id) AS response_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prompt_batches c WHERE c.project_id = pb.project_id AND c.session_id = pb.session_id AND c.parent_prompt_id = pb.prompt_id) AS child_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plans p WHERE p.project_id = pb.project_id AND p.session_id = pb.session_id AND p.prompt_id = pb.prompt_id) AS plan_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachments a WHERE a.project_id = pb.project_id AND a.session_id = pb.session_id AND a.prompt_id = pb.prompt_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = a.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = a.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = a.prompt_id)) AS attachment_count
                FROM prompt_batches pb
               WHERE pb.project_id = ? AND pb.session_id = ? AND pb.parent_prompt_id IS NULL AND pb.origin IN (?) AND (pb.created_at > ? OR (pb.created_at = ? AND pb.prompt_id > ?))
               ORDER BY pb.created_at ASC, pb.prompt_id ASC LIMIT ?

SELECT pb.prompt_id, pb.origin, pb.prompt_kind, pb.thread_label, substr(pb.text, 1, 160) AS preview, length(pb.text) AS text_chars, pb.blob_key, pb.created_at,
                     (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tool_calls t WHERE t.project_id = pb.project_id AND t.session_id = pb.session_id AND t.prompt_id = pb.prompt_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = t.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = t.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = t.prompt_id)) AS tool_call_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM responses r WHERE r.project_id = pb.project_id AND r.prompt_id = pb.prompt_id) AS response_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prompt_batches c WHERE c.project_id = pb.project_id AND c.session_id = pb.session_id AND c.parent_prompt_id = pb.prompt_id) AS child_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plans p WHERE p.project_id = pb.project_id AND p.session_id = pb.session_id AND p.prompt_id = pb.prompt_id) AS plan_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachments a WHERE a.project_id = pb.project_id AND a.session_id = pb.session_id AND a.prompt_id = pb.prompt_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = a.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = a.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = a.prompt_id)) AS attachment_count
                FROM prompt_batches pb
               WHERE pb.project_id = ? AND pb.session_id = ? AND pb.parent_prompt_id IS NULL AND pb.origin IN (?)
               ORDER BY pb.created_at ASC, pb.prompt_id ASC LIMIT ?

SELECT pb.prompt_id, pb.origin, pb.prompt_kind, pb.parent_prompt_id, pb.thread_label, pb.text, pb.blob_key, pb.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tool_calls t WHERE t.project_id = pb.project_id AND t.session_id = pb.session_id AND t.prompt_id = pb.prompt_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = t.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = t.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = t.prompt_id)) AS tool_call_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prompt_batches c WHERE c.project_id = pb.project_id AND c.session_id = pb.session_id AND c.parent_prompt_id = pb.prompt_id) AS child_count FROM prompt_batches pb
    WHERE pb.project_id = ? AND pb.session_id = ? AND pb.parent_prompt_id = ? 
    ORDER BY +pb.created_at ASC, pb.prompt_id ASC LIMIT ?

SELECT pb.prompt_id, pb.origin, pb.prompt_kind, pb.parent_prompt_id, pb.thread_label, pb.text, pb.blob_key, pb.created_at,
    (SELECT MAX(+created_at) FROM responses WHERE project_id = pb.project_id AND session_id = pb.session_id AND prompt_id = pb.prompt_id) AS last_reply,
    (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('toolName', tool_name, 'count', n)) FROM (
      SELECT tool_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM tool_calls WHERE project_id = pb.project_id AND session_id = pb.session_id AND prompt_id = pb.prompt_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = tool_calls.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = tool_calls.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = tool_calls.prompt_id)
    GROUP BY +tool_name ORDER BY n DESC, tool_name ASC)) AS tools,
    (SELECT json_object('receiptId', i.id, 'sporeIds', i.spore_ids, 'createdAt', i.created_at, 'planIds', json(COALESCE(i.plan_ids, '[]')))
      FROM spore_injections i WHERE i.project_id = pb.project_id AND i.session_id = pb.session_id AND i.delivered_prompt_id = pb.prompt_id
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = i.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = i.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = i.delivered_prompt_id)
      ORDER BY +i.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS injection,
    (SELECT agent FROM sessions s WHERE s.project_id = pb.project_id AND s.session_id = pb.session_id) AS agent
    FROM (SELECT value AS wanted_prompt FROM json_each(?)) wanted CROSS JOIN prompt_batches pb
    WHERE pb.project_id = ? AND pb.session_id = ? AND pb.prompt_id = wanted.wanted_prompt

SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT response_id, prompt_id, text, blob_key, created_at, created_at AS order_at, response_id,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY prompt_id ORDER BY created_at ASC, response_id ASC) AS page_row
    FROM (SELECT value AS wanted_prompt FROM json_each(?)) wanted CROSS JOIN responses
    WHERE project_id = ? AND session_id = ? AND prompt_id = wanted.wanted_prompt
      
  ) WHERE page_row <= ? ORDER BY prompt_id, order_at ASC, response_id ASC

SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = attachments.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = attachments.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = attachments.prompt_id) THEN attachments.prompt_id ELSE NULL END AS prompt_id, attachment_id, blob_key, media_type, byte_size, description, created_at, created_at AS order_at, attachment_id,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY prompt_id ORDER BY created_at ASC, attachment_id ASC) AS page_row
    FROM (SELECT value AS wanted_prompt FROM json_each(?)) wanted CROSS JOIN attachments
    WHERE project_id = ? AND session_id = ? AND prompt_id = wanted.wanted_prompt
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = attachments.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = attachments.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = attachments.prompt_id)
  ) WHERE page_row <= ? ORDER BY prompt_id, order_at ASC, attachment_id ASC

SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT plan_key, prompt_id, title, status, content, blob_key, origin_path, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, CAST(0 AS INTEGER) AS order_at, plan_key,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY prompt_id ORDER BY CAST(0 AS INTEGER) ASC, plan_key ASC) AS page_row
    FROM (SELECT value AS wanted_prompt FROM json_each(?)) wanted CROSS JOIN plans
    WHERE project_id = ? AND session_id = ? AND prompt_id = wanted.wanted_prompt
      
  ) WHERE page_row <= ? ORDER BY prompt_id, order_at ASC, plan_key ASC

SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = prompt_context_answers.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = prompt_context_answers.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = prompt_context_answers.prompt_id) THEN prompt_context_answers.prompt_id ELSE NULL END AS prompt_id, id, created_at, outcome, context_chars, parts, skipped, failures, selection, created_at AS order_at, id,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY prompt_id ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC) AS page_row
    FROM (SELECT value AS wanted_prompt FROM json_each(?)) wanted CROSS JOIN prompt_context_answers
    WHERE project_id = ? AND session_id = ? AND prompt_id = wanted.wanted_prompt
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = prompt_context_answers.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = prompt_context_answers.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = prompt_context_answers.prompt_id)
  ) WHERE page_row <= ? ORDER BY prompt_id, order_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN t.success = 0 AND (t.result_reason = 'reported' OR t.result_reason IS NULL) THEN 'failure' WHEN t.success = 0 AND t.result_reason IN ('no_result', 'pending_limit') THEN 'no_result' END AS type,
      t.tool_call_id AS id, t.tool_name AS tool_name, t.result_reason AS result_reason, t.created_at AS at,
      CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = t.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = t.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = t.prompt_id) THEN t.prompt_id ELSE NULL END AS prompt_id
    FROM tool_calls t WHERE t.project_id = ? AND t.session_id = ? AND ((t.success = 0 AND (t.result_reason = 'reported' OR t.result_reason IS NULL)) OR (t.success = 0 AND t.result_reason IN ('no_result', 'pending_limit')))
    ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.tool_call_id DESC LIMIT ?

SELECT e.type, e.edge, e.id, e.at, e.related, e.title, e.first_prompt, e.agent, e.reason
    FROM (SELECT 'child_session' AS type, 'child' AS edge, 'child:' || r.session_id AS id, COALESCE(r.occurred_started_at, r.started_at, r.first_received_at) AS at, r.session_id AS related, r.title AS title,
    (SELECT substr(pb.text, 1, 160) FROM prompt_batches pb
       WHERE pb.project_id = r.project_id AND pb.session_id = r.session_id AND pb.origin = 'user' AND pb.text IS NOT NULL
       ORDER BY pb.created_at, pb.prompt_id LIMIT 1) AS first_prompt, r.agent AS agent, NULL AS reason
      FROM sessions r INDEXED BY idx_sessions_launch_parent WHERE r.project_id = ? AND r.launch_parent_session_id = ? AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM session_tombstones t WHERE t.project_id = r.project_id AND t.session_id = r.session_id) UNION ALL SELECT 'continuation' AS type, 'continued_by' AS edge, 'continued_by:' || r.session_id AS id, COALESCE(r.occurred_started_at, r.started_at, r.first_received_at) AS at, r.session_id AS related, r.title AS title,
    (SELECT substr(pb.text, 1, 160) FROM prompt_batches pb
       WHERE pb.project_id = r.project_id AND pb.session_id = r.session_id AND pb.origin = 'user' AND pb.text IS NOT NULL
       ORDER BY pb.created_at, pb.prompt_id LIMIT 1) AS first_prompt, r.agent AS agent, r.parent_reason AS reason
      FROM sessions r INDEXED BY idx_sessions_parent WHERE r.project_id = ? AND r.parent_session_id = ? AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM session_tombstones t WHERE t.project_id = r.project_id AND t.session_id = r.session_id) UNION ALL SELECT 'continuation' AS type, 'continues' AS edge, 'continues:' || s.parent_session_id AS id, COALESCE(s.occurred_started_at, s.started_at, s.first_received_at) AS at, r.session_id AS related, r.title AS title,
    (SELECT substr(pb.text, 1, 160) FROM prompt_batches pb
       WHERE pb.project_id = r.project_id AND pb.session_id = r.session_id AND pb.origin = 'user' AND pb.text IS NOT NULL
       ORDER BY pb.created_at, pb.prompt_id LIMIT 1) AS first_prompt, r.agent AS agent, s.parent_reason AS reason
      FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN sessions r ON r.project_id = s.project_id AND r.session_id = s.parent_session_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM session_tombstones t WHERE t.project_id = r.project_id AND t.session_id = r.session_id)
      WHERE s.project_id = ? AND s.session_id = ? AND s.parent_session_id IS NOT NULL) e 
    ORDER BY e.at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT ?

SELECT DISTINCT t.tool_name FROM tool_calls t WHERE t.project_id = ? AND t.session_id = ?
    AND ((t.success = 0 AND (t.result_reason = 'reported' OR t.result_reason IS NULL)) OR (t.success = 0 AND t.result_reason IN ('no_result', 'pending_limit'))) ORDER BY t.tool_name

SELECT s.project_id, s.session_id, s.machine_id, s.created_by_token_id, s.first_received_at, s.last_received_at,
     s.agent, s.branch, COALESCE(s.occurred_started_at, s.started_at) AS started_at, COALESCE(s.occurred_ended_at, s.ended_at) AS ended_at, s.origin_path, s.parent_session_id, s.parent_reason, s.launch_parent_session_id,
     s.title, s.summary, s.titled_at, s.ended_by, (SELECT substr(pb.text, 1, 160) FROM prompt_batches pb
       WHERE pb.project_id = s.project_id AND pb.session_id = s.session_id AND pb.origin = 'user' AND pb.text IS NOT NULL
       ORDER BY pb.created_at, pb.prompt_id LIMIT 1) AS first_prompt,
     c.member_id, c.runtime_kind, m.label AS member_label, e.label AS ended_by_label, s.working_since FROM sessions s
     LEFT JOIN member_credentials c ON c.id = s.created_by_token_id
     LEFT JOIN members m ON m.id = c.member_id
     LEFT JOIN members e ON e.id = s.ended_by WHERE s.project_id = ? AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM session_tombstones t WHERE t.project_id = s.project_id AND t.session_id = s.session_id) ORDER BY COALESCE(s.occurred_started_at, s.started_at, s.first_received_at) DESC, s.session_id DESC LIMIT ?

SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT 'session' AS type, s.session_id AS id, '' AS summary,
               COALESCE(s.occurred_started_at, s.started_at, s.first_received_at) AS at_ms, s.session_id AS session_id,
               s.title AS title, (SELECT substr(pb.text, 1, 160) FROM prompt_batches pb
       WHERE pb.project_id = s.project_id AND pb.session_id = s.session_id AND pb.origin = 'user' AND pb.text IS NOT NULL
       ORDER BY pb.created_at, pb.prompt_id LIMIT 1) AS first_prompt, s.agent AS agent
          FROM sessions s WHERE s.project_id = ? AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM session_tombstones t WHERE t.project_id = s.project_id AND t.session_id = s.session_id) ORDER BY at_ms DESC LIMIT ?)
      UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT 'run' AS type, id, COALESCE(task, 'run') || ' — ' || status AS summary,
               COALESCE(resumed_at, started_at, completed_at, queued_at) AS at_ms, NULL AS session_id, NULL AS title, NULL AS first_prompt, NULL AS agent
          FROM agent_runs WHERE project_id = ? AND COALESCE(resumed_at, started_at, completed_at, queued_at) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY at_ms DESC LIMIT ?)
      UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT 'spore' AS type, id, observation_type || ': ' || substr(content, 1, 80) AS summary,
               created_at AS at_ms, session_id, NULL AS title, NULL AS first_prompt, NULL AS agent
          FROM spores WHERE project_id = ? AND status = 'active' ORDER BY at_ms DESC LIMIT ?)
      ORDER BY at_ms DESC LIMIT ?

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.occurred_ended_at, s.ended_at) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open,
                     SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.occurred_started_at, s.started_at, s.first_received_at) >= ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent, MAX(last_received_at) AS last
                FROM sessions s WHERE s.project_id = ? AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM session_tombstones t WHERE t.project_id = s.project_id AND t.session_id = s.session_id)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM prompt_batches WHERE project_id = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM tool_calls WHERE project_id = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM plans WHERE project_id = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM attachments WHERE project_id = ?

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM search_blob_queue q
    WHERE q.complete = 0 AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches p WHERE p.project_id = q.project_id AND p.blob_key = q.blob_key AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM processed_resources pr WHERE pr.project_id = p.project_id AND pr.kind = 'prompt'
    AND pr.resource_id = p.prompt_id AND pr.blob_key = p.blob_key AND pr.classification = 'processed'))
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM responses r WHERE r.project_id = q.project_id AND r.blob_key = q.blob_key AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM processed_resources pr WHERE pr.project_id = r.project_id AND pr.kind = 'response'
    AND pr.resource_id = r.response_id AND pr.blob_key = r.blob_key AND pr.classification = 'processed'))
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plans p WHERE p.project_id = q.project_id AND p.blob_key = q.blob_key AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM processed_resources pr WHERE pr.project_id = p.project_id AND pr.kind = 'plan'
    AND pr.resource_id = p.plan_key AND pr.blob_key = p.blob_key AND pr.classification = 'processed'))) AND q.project_id = ?

WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.rowid AS source_rowid, sessions_fts.rank AS rank, 0 AS branch, sessions_fts.rowid AS match_rowid
    FROM sessions_fts CROSS JOIN sessions d ON d.rowid = sessions_fts.rowid
    WHERE sessions_fts MATCH ? AND d.project_id = ?),
    kept AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.project_id, d.session_id AS id, COALESCE(NULLIF(d.title, ''), 'Session ' || substr(d.session_id, -6)) AS title, MIN(candidates.rank) AS rank,
      candidates.branch, candidates.match_rowid, NULL AS line,
      COALESCE(d.occurred_started_at, d.started_at, d.first_received_at) AS created_at, d.session_id AS session_id, NULL AS prompt_id
    FROM candidates CROSS JOIN sessions d ON d.rowid = candidates.source_rowid
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM session_tombstones t WHERE t.project_id = d.project_id AND t.session_id = d.session_id) GROUP BY d.rowid ORDER BY rank, created_at DESC, id, d.project_id LIMIT ?)
    SELECT kept.project_id, kept.id, kept.title, kept.rank, kept.created_at, kept.session_id, kept.prompt_id, (SELECT agent FROM sessions WHERE project_id = kept.project_id AND session_id = kept.session_id) AS agent, (SELECT snippet(sessions_fts, -1, '', '', ' … ', 40) FROM sessions_fts WHERE sessions_fts MATCH ? AND sessions_fts.rowid = kept.match_rowid) AS preview
    FROM kept  ORDER BY kept.rank, kept.created_at DESC, kept.id, kept.project_id

WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.rowid AS source_rowid, spores_fts.rank AS rank, 0 AS branch, spores_fts.rowid AS match_rowid
    FROM spores_fts CROSS JOIN spores d ON d.rowid = spores_fts.rowid
    WHERE spores_fts MATCH ? AND d.project_id = ?),
    kept AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.project_id, d.id AS id, d.observation_type AS title, MIN(candidates.rank) AS rank,
      candidates.branch, candidates.match_rowid, d.agent_line AS line,
      d.created_at AS created_at, d.session_id AS session_id, NULL AS prompt_id
    FROM candidates CROSS JOIN spores d ON d.rowid = candidates.source_rowid
     GROUP BY d.rowid ORDER BY rank, created_at DESC, id, d.project_id LIMIT ?)
    SELECT kept.project_id, kept.id, kept.title, kept.rank, kept.created_at, kept.session_id, kept.prompt_id, (SELECT agent FROM sessions WHERE project_id = kept.project_id AND session_id = kept.session_id) AS agent, COALESCE(NULLIF(kept.line, ''), (SELECT snippet(spores_fts, -1, '', '', ' … ', 40) FROM spores_fts WHERE spores_fts MATCH ? AND spores_fts.rowid = kept.match_rowid)) AS preview
    FROM kept  ORDER BY kept.rank, kept.created_at DESC, kept.id, kept.project_id

WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.rowid AS source_rowid, plans_fts.rank AS rank, 0 AS branch, plans_fts.rowid AS match_rowid
    FROM plans_fts CROSS JOIN plans d ON d.rowid = plans_fts.rowid
    WHERE plans_fts MATCH ? AND d.project_id = ? UNION ALL SELECT d.rowid AS source_rowid, search_blob_chunks_fts.rank AS rank, 1 AS branch,
    search_blob_chunks_fts.rowid AS match_rowid
    FROM search_blob_chunks_fts CROSS JOIN search_blob_chunks c ON c.rowid = search_blob_chunks_fts.rowid
    CROSS JOIN plans d ON d.project_id = c.project_id AND d.blob_key = c.blob_key
    WHERE search_blob_chunks_fts MATCH ? AND d.project_id = ? AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM processed_resources pr WHERE pr.project_id = d.project_id AND pr.kind = 'plan'
    AND pr.resource_id = d.plan_key AND pr.blob_key = d.blob_key AND pr.classification = 'processed')),
    kept AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.project_id, d.plan_key AS id, COALESCE(NULLIF(d.title, ''), 'Plan') AS title, MIN(candidates.rank) AS rank,
      candidates.branch, candidates.match_rowid, NULL AS line,
      d.created_at AS created_at, d.session_id AS session_id, d.prompt_id AS prompt_id
    FROM candidates CROSS JOIN plans d ON d.rowid = candidates.source_rowid
     GROUP BY d.rowid ORDER BY rank, created_at DESC, id, d.project_id LIMIT ?)
    SELECT kept.project_id, kept.id, kept.title, kept.rank, kept.created_at, kept.session_id, kept.prompt_id, (SELECT agent FROM sessions WHERE project_id = kept.project_id AND session_id = kept.session_id) AS agent, CASE kept.branch WHEN 0 THEN (SELECT snippet(plans_fts, -1, '', '', ' … ', 40) FROM plans_fts WHERE plans_fts MATCH ? AND plans_fts.rowid = kept.match_rowid) ELSE (SELECT snippet(search_blob_chunks_fts, 0, '', '', ' … ', 40) FROM search_blob_chunks_fts
    WHERE search_blob_chunks_fts MATCH ? AND search_blob_chunks_fts.rowid = kept.match_rowid) END AS preview
    FROM kept  ORDER BY kept.rank, kept.created_at DESC, kept.id, kept.project_id

WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.rowid AS source_rowid, prompt_batches_fts.rank AS rank, 0 AS branch, prompt_batches_fts.rowid AS match_rowid
    FROM prompt_batches_fts CROSS JOIN prompt_batches d ON d.rowid = prompt_batches_fts.rowid
    WHERE prompt_batches_fts MATCH ? AND d.project_id = ? UNION ALL SELECT d.rowid AS source_rowid, search_blob_chunks_fts.rank AS rank, 1 AS branch,
    search_blob_chunks_fts.rowid AS match_rowid
    FROM search_blob_chunks_fts CROSS JOIN search_blob_chunks c ON c.rowid = search_blob_chunks_fts.rowid
    CROSS JOIN prompt_batches d ON d.project_id = c.project_id AND d.blob_key = c.blob_key
    WHERE search_blob_chunks_fts MATCH ? AND d.project_id = ? AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM processed_resources pr WHERE pr.project_id = d.project_id AND pr.kind = 'prompt'
    AND pr.resource_id = d.prompt_id AND pr.blob_key = d.blob_key AND pr.classification = 'processed')),
    kept AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.project_id, d.prompt_id AS id, 'Prompt' AS title, MIN(candidates.rank) AS rank,
      candidates.branch, candidates.match_rowid, NULL AS line,
      d.created_at AS created_at, d.session_id AS session_id, d.prompt_id AS prompt_id
    FROM candidates CROSS JOIN prompt_batches d ON d.rowid = candidates.source_rowid
     GROUP BY d.rowid ORDER BY rank, created_at DESC, id, d.project_id LIMIT ?)
    SELECT kept.project_id, kept.id, kept.title, kept.rank, kept.created_at, kept.session_id, kept.prompt_id, (SELECT agent FROM sessions WHERE project_id = kept.project_id AND session_id = kept.session_id) AS agent, CASE kept.branch WHEN 0 THEN (SELECT snippet(prompt_batches_fts, -1, '', '', ' … ', 40) FROM prompt_batches_fts WHERE prompt_batches_fts MATCH ? AND prompt_batches_fts.rowid = kept.match_rowid) ELSE (SELECT snippet(search_blob_chunks_fts, 0, '', '', ' … ', 40) FROM search_blob_chunks_fts
    WHERE search_blob_chunks_fts MATCH ? AND search_blob_chunks_fts.rowid = kept.match_rowid) END AS preview, tp.prompt_id AS turn_id, substr(tp.text, 1, 160) AS turn_preview, length(tp.text) AS turn_chars, tp.blob_key IS NOT NULL AS turn_stored
    FROM kept LEFT JOIN prompt_batches rp ON rp.project_id = kept.project_id AND rp.session_id = kept.session_id AND rp.prompt_id = kept.prompt_id
    LEFT JOIN prompt_batches tp ON tp.project_id = rp.project_id AND tp.session_id = rp.session_id AND tp.prompt_id = COALESCE(rp.parent_prompt_id, rp.prompt_id) AND tp.parent_prompt_id IS NULL ORDER BY kept.rank, kept.created_at DESC, kept.id, kept.project_id

WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.rowid AS source_rowid, responses_fts.rank AS rank, 0 AS branch, responses_fts.rowid AS match_rowid

    FROM candidates CROSS JOIN responses d ON d.rowid = candidates.source_rowid
     GROUP BY d.rowid ORDER BY rank, created_at DESC, id, d.project_id LIMIT ?)
    SELECT kept.project_id, kept.id, kept.title, kept.rank, kept.created_at, kept.session_id, kept.prompt_id, (SELECT agent FROM sessions WHERE project_id = kept.project_id AND session_id = kept.session_id) AS agent, CASE kept.branch WHEN 0 THEN (SELECT snippet(responses_fts, -1, '', '', ' … ', 40) FROM responses_fts WHERE responses_fts MATCH ? AND responses_fts.rowid = kept.match_rowid) ELSE (SELECT snippet(search_blob_chunks_fts, 0, '', '', ' … ', 40) FROM search_blob_chunks_fts
    WHERE search_blob_chunks_fts MATCH ? AND search_blob_chunks_fts.rowid = kept.match_rowid) END AS preview, tp.prompt_id AS turn_id, substr(tp.text, 1, 160) AS turn_preview, length(tp.text) AS turn_chars, tp.blob_key IS NOT NULL AS turn_stored
    FROM kept LEFT JOIN prompt_batches rp ON rp.project_id = kept.project_id AND rp.session_id = kept.session_id AND rp.prompt_id = kept.prompt_id
    LEFT JOIN prompt_batches tp ON tp.project_id = rp.project_id AND tp.session_id = rp.session_id AND tp.prompt_id = COALESCE(rp.parent_prompt_id, rp.prompt_id) AND tp.parent_prompt_id IS NULL ORDER BY kept.rank, kept.created_at DESC, kept.id, kept.project_id

SELECT * FROM (SELECT project_id, session_id, 'session_context:' || kind AS record_key,
    'session_context' AS record_kind, kind AS record_id, r.placement_hint AS prompt_hint,
    CASE WHEN kind = 'plan-nudge' THEN 'Plan reminder' ELSE 'Context for a sub-agent' END AS label, created_at FROM (SELECT si.*, (SELECT MAX(json_extract(e.payload, '$.parentPromptId')) FROM events e INDEXED BY idx_events_subagent_start
      WHERE e.project_id = si.project_id AND e.session_id = si.session_id AND e.kind = 'subagent.start'
        AND json_extract(e.payload, '$.subagentId') = json_extract(agent.value, '$.subagent_id')
      HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT json_extract(e.payload, '$.parentPromptId')) = 1
        AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(json_extract(e.payload, '$.parentPromptId'))) AS placement_hint
      FROM json_each(?) agent CROSS JOIN session_injections si
      WHERE si.project_id = json_extract(agent.value, '$.project_id') AND si.session_id = json_extract(agent.value, '$.session_id')
        AND si.kind = json_extract(agent.value, '$.kind')
      UNION ALL SELECT si.*, si.delivered_prompt_id AS placement_hint FROM (SELECT r.* FROM projects pr CROSS JOIN session_injections r WHERE r.project_id = pr.project_id AND r.project_id = ? AND r.session_id = ?) si
      WHERE si.kind = 'plan-nudge' AND si.delivered_at IS NOT NULL) r
    WHERE 1 = 1
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prompt_batches hook_prompt WHERE hook_prompt.project_id = r.project_id
    AND hook_prompt.session_id = r.session_id AND hook_prompt.prompt_id = r.placement_hint))
    WHERE project_id = ? AND session_id = ? 
    ORDER BY created_at, record_key LIMIT ?
